description: This is a Java unit test file for the class JavaValueFieldDefinition, testing its immutability, equality, null handling, marker inclusion, string representation, and value mapping functionalities.

classes.name: JavaValueFieldDefinitionTest
classes.description: A test class for JavaValueFieldDefinition, verifying immutability, equality, null handling, marker checks, string representation, and mapping logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that JavaValueFieldDefinition instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies equals and hashCode implementation using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that creating an instance with null JSON pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullValueType
methods.description: Checks that creating an instance with null value type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getPointer() returns the correct JsonPointer.

methods.name: getValueTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getValueType() returns the expected class type.

methods.name: getMarkersReturnsUnmodifiableSet
methods.description: Ensures getMarkers() returns an unmodifiable set.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsTrueIfDefinitionContainsAskedMarkers
methods.description: Verifies isMarkedAs() returns true if specified markers are contained.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsFalseIfDefinitionContainsNotAllAskedMarkers
methods.description: Verifies isMarkedAs() returns false if some markers are missing.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsTrueIfDefinitionContainsAskedMarker
methods.description: Checks if isMarkedAs() returns true when asking for a marker present in the definition.

methods.name: stringRepresentationContainsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toString() output contains key property names and values.

methods.name: tryToMapJavaNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that mapping a null JsonValue throws NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: mapValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that mapValue() correctly maps JsonValue to its Java value.

methods.name: mapJsonNullLiteralWithStringFieldDefinition
methods.description: Ensures mapping a null literal returns null.

methods.name: mapJsonNullLiteralWithIntFieldDefinition
methods.description: Ensures mapping a null literal returns null for Integer type.

methods.name: tryToMapBooleanWithIntFieldDefinition
methods.description: Checks that mapping a boolean JSON value with an integer field definition throws JsonParseException.

methods.name: mapIntWithIntFieldDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that mapping an int JsonValue returns its integer value.
